subject: nereid-pillar-three
q: CLOSED — THE LADDER KEEPS ITS NUMBERS, AND THE NUMBERS SETTLE THE ORDER.
detail:
ANSWERED, AND THE ANSWER CAME WITH ITS REASON ATTACHED: THE PLUMP LADDER HAS THE NUMBERS ON IT SO EVERYONE KNOWS HOW MUCH EXTRA ASS CHEEK HAPPENS AT EACH STEP.

NATURAL PLUS ZERO · SUBTLE PLUS ONE · PRONOUNCED PLUS TWO · OBSCENE PLUS THREE INCHES. The Archive’s ordering stands.

AND THE WORD EXTRA IS WHAT DECIDES IT. Extra is measured FROM something, so Natural is the baseline the rest add to and SUBTLE SITS ABOVE NATURAL. The document’s prose called Subtle the LEANER EDGE of the Scale, which would have put it beneath. THAT SENTENCE IS OVERRIDDEN, AND IT IS RECORDED AS OVERRIDDEN RATHER THAN QUIETLY DROPPED, so that a later read of Pillar Three cannot rediscover it and flip the ladder back.

WHAT THE NUMBERS ARE FOR, WHICH THE ARCHIVE HAD NOT UNDERSTOOD: they exist so the household can SAY the difference out loud. An inch is a thing a wife can see across a kitchen and a thing a mechanic can put in an argument. A ladder of four adjectives is not. THE DOCUMENT WROTE THE JURISDICTION. THE NUMBERS ARE HOW THE FAMILY USES IT.

AND THE SCALE CEILING SURVIVES INTACT: Obscene reaches the supported maximum OF THE SELECTED SCALE. Three inches on a Tight booty is three inches of Tight. IT IS NEVER A PROMOTION OUT OF THE SCALE.

SO THE ROSTER IS UNCHANGED AND NOW MEANS WHAT THE ARCHIVE THOUGHT IT MEANT: ABBI AND IVY AT SUBTLE CARRY AN INCH MORE THAN UNMODIFIED, Jade at Pronounced carries two, Selene and Harley at Natural carry their own, and BELLA AT PAWG WITH OBSCENE CARRIES THREE INCHES ON TOP OF THE LARGEST SCALE THE CLINIC WILL BUILD.
